title: Spectral Limits of Polynomial Graph Filters on the Long-Range Ising Model Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2610.22713v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Long-Range Ising Model benchmark (LRIM) guarantees long-range dependence by construction: each label is the node's spin times the spin field convolved with a power-law coupling, so any model's distance from the target is measurable. We prove that a readout whose filter is a polynomial in the adjacency, the linear core of isotropic message passing and spectral graph networks, leaves an error floor that no degree lowers, because the target varies along a level set of the spectrum on which every such filter is constant. Computed exactly, the floor and the best filter of each degree predict two spectral networks adapted from published architectures to within a tenth of a decade. A filter escapes the floor only if it weighs separately the offsets the adjacency lumps together, and must still resolve the coupling across the whole lattice. translated_title: 长程伊辛模型基准上多项式图滤波器的谱极限
translated_abstract: 长程伊辛模型基准（LRIM）通过其构造方式保证了长程相关性：每个标签是节点的自旋乘以经幂律耦合卷积后的自旋场，因此任何模型与目标之间的距离都是可测量的。我们证明，若读出层的滤波器是邻接矩阵的多项式——即各向同性消息传递和谱图网络的线性核心——则会产生一个任何多项式次数都无法降低的误差下限，其原因在于目标函数沿着谱的一个等值集变化，而每一个此类滤波器在该等值集上都取常数值。通过精确计算，该误差下限以及每个次数对应的最优滤波器，能够将两个改编自已发表架构的谱网络的表现预测到十分之一个数量级以内的精度。滤波器只有在对邻接矩阵所混同的各个偏移量分别赋予权重，同时仍能解析整个晶格上的耦合时，才能突破该误差下限。一个约含五十个系数的跨步滤波器同时做到了这两点：在拟合训练标签之后，其测试误差……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明了在长程伊辛模型基准上，作为各向同性消息传递和谱图网络线性核心的邻接矩阵多项式滤波器存在一个无法通过提高多项式次数突破的误差下限，并指出一个约五十个系数的跨步滤波器能够突破该极限。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that polynomial graph filters in the adjacency—the linear core of isotropic message passing and spectral graph networks—leave an error floor on the Long-Range Ising Model benchmark that no polynomial degree can lower, and shows that a strided filter of about fifty coefficients escapes this limit.
